front.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
front.tldr: OpenAI's autonomous pipeline found, validated and wrote patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel, a large-scale demonstration of AI-assisted security research.

front.title: Apple's fiscal 2026 in charts
front.tldr: Apple closed its record fiscal 2026 with an all-time quarterly revenue high, and Six Colors charts how each product line contributed to the result.

front.title: Kimi Antonelli to honour Ayrton Senna with special helmet at Brazilian GP
front.tldr: Kimi Antonelli arrives at Interlagos as 2026 world champion and will wear a helmet honouring his hero Ayrton Senna at this weekend's Brazilian Grand Prix.

stories.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
stories.tldr: Meta has acquired Conductor, a startup that lets software engineers deploy teams of AI agents to work on different parts of a project at the same time.

stories.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company
stories.tldr: OpenAI is acquiring Pierre Computer Company to expand Codex's tools for building, understanding and reviewing code.

stories.title: Introducing Images 2.6
stories.tldr: OpenAI's Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, GIF creation, more precise editing and new API controls across ChatGPT, Codex and the API.

stories.title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber
stories.tldr: During its busiest week last quarter, Uber says only four people used an AI agent to book a ride, a reality check on agentic commerce hype.

stories.title: Snapchat surpasses 30M paid subscribers
stories.tldr: Snapchat has passed 30 million paid subscribers across Snapchat+ and other plans, a year after it began charging for extra Memories storage.

stories.title: Sequoia hits rewind, undoing 20 years of expansion
stories.tldr: Sequoia is shrinking back to a smaller, Bay Area-centred firm, closing offices and programmes built over 20 years while raising roughly $10 billion in new funds.

stories.title: Redditor uses AI to get Switch games running natively on Apple TV
stories.tldr: A Reddit user used AI coding tools, including Claude Code, to get Nintendo Switch games such as Super Mario Odyssey running natively on the Apple TV 4K.

stories.title: Bluetooth is going to get a lot faster in 2027
stories.tldr: Bluetooth's new HDT standard is set to roll out in 2027, promising a significant speed increase for headphones, speakers and other wireless devices.

stories.title: Siri AI's Evolution Is Both Surprising and Obvious
stories.tldr: Apple's 27.3 developer betas bring a substantial expansion of Siri AI's capabilities, and MacStories traces how the assistant's abilities have grown since the iOS 27 launch.

stories.title: iPad Mini (A20 Pro) Review Roundup
stories.tldr: Early reviews of the new A20 Pro iPad Mini single out its Acoustic Display, which fires sound from the front panel rather than speaker holes, for mixed praise.

stories.title: Apple Releases Xcode 27.3 Beta With Three New Features
stories.tldr: Xcode 27.3 beta adds three new features for developers, including GitHub Copilot support in Apple's built-in coding assistant and the ability to test Siri AI integration in apps.

stories.title: Pixar Names Jonathan Garson as President; Jim Morris Moves to Emeritus Role
stories.tldr: Pixar is handing the presidency to Jonathan Garson, who has worked at Disney for more than 30 years, after Jim Morris's 12 years in the role.

stories.title: AMC Theatres Sets All-Time Record for Quarterly Revenue
stories.tldr: AMC Theatres posted record quarterly revenue of $1.71 billion, driven by the box-office success of Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey.

stories.title: Box Office: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' to Lead With $30 Million Opening Weekend
stories.tldr: Godzilla Minus Zero is on track for a $30 million opening weekend from 3,254 North American cinemas, with Cat in the Hat debuting around $20 million.

stories.title: Milcho Manchevski's 'Sister Brother Manhole Cover' Wins Top Prize at Tokyo Film Fest
stories.tldr: Macedonian director Milcho Manchevski's Sister Brother Manhole Cover, an examination of family and the wealth gap, won the Grand Prix as the Tokyo Film Festival closed after ten days.

stories.title: Paul George and Derrick White lead Celtics past Bucks, 109-102
stories.tldr: Paul George and Derrick White led the Celtics past the Bucks 109-102 after Boston blew a 22-point lead, with Baylor Scheierman adding nine points and 11 rebounds off the bench.

stories.title: What Drake Maye, Mike Vrabel said about Tom Brady's return to Gillette Stadium
stories.tldr: Tom Brady is returning to Gillette Stadium, and Patriots coach Mike Vrabel says he is contractually required to catch up with him at some point.

stories.title: How the F1 world reacted to Charles Leclerc becoming a father
stories.tldr: Charles Leclerc and his wife Alexandra have announced the birth of their first child, a daughter named Bianca, drawing congratulations from across Formula 1.

stories.title: Liam Lawson's remarkable form is giving Red Bull a headache for 2027
stories.tldr: Liam Lawson has scored 83 points so far this season, nearly double Pierre Gasly's 42, making him Formula 1's standout midfield performer and a problem for Red Bull's 2027 plans.

stories.title: Mercedes to race in new suits at Brazil GP in nod to legendary era
stories.tldr: Mercedes will swap their usual look for purple race suits at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, with champion Kimi Antonelli and George Russell honouring the team's legendary era.

stories.title: Red Sox could add offense this offseason with Japanese Triple Crown winner
stories.tldr: The Red Sox are reportedly eyeing Teruaki Sato, who hit .306/.383/.609 with 40 doubles and 39 home runs in Japan last season, as an offseason target.

read.why: Snapchat just passed 30 million paid subscribers, a good moment for this framework on building consumer subscription growth loops.
read.title: The Subscription Value Loop: A framework for growing consumer subscription businesses
read.subtitle: Including case studies, templates, and 10 proven growth tactics from top consumer subscription apps like Duolingo, Spotify, Tinder, and Calm

listen.why: New today: the story of One Piece creator Eiichiro Oda's single-minded devotion to his craft, a counterpoint to the day's product and launch news.
listen.title: #439 How Eiichiro Oda Works

listen.why: New today: a16z's first employee turned U.S. government HR chief on building institutions and venture lessons that still apply.
listen.title: a16z's First Employee on the History of a16z, Venture Capital & Fixing the Government | Scott Kupor

listen.why: A back-catalogue pick for today's Nintendo news, the Switch cartridge supplier's exit and a Reddit hack running Switch games on Apple TV.
listen.title: Nintendo: The Console Wars

finally.title: Cinematography Legend Robert Richardson Answered a Film Student's Email. Their Conversation Became 'The White Devil'
finally.tldr: Jana Hojdova wanted to ask Oscar-winning cinematographer Robert Richardson about his life. A pandemic correspondence and 650 hours of footage later, her documentary captures what it means to be understood.
